field_evidence.dataset_title: Fires in London - cause of ignition is white goods
field_evidence.description_scope: Fires where the ignition source is recorded as white goods; records include London borough and ward location, white-goods type and property type, with brand/model where known.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade dataset 'Fires in London - cause of ignition is white goods'. The dataset covers fires from January 2009 through July 2025 and records London borough and ward location, white-goods type and property type; its smallest geography is Ward. This batch binds the already verified Campden ward identity E05009390 to that unused official ward-level source; the Campden row extraction, geometry and parcel spatial join remain deferred to local OpenCode.
